title: Structure-activity relationships among mono- and dihydroxy flavones as aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) agonists or antagonists in CACO2 cells.
authors: Park, Hyejin; Jin, Un-Ho; Martin, Gregory; Chapkin, Robert S; Davidson, Laurie A; Lee, Kyongbum; Jayaraman, Arul; Safe, Stephen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物与芳香烃受体(AhR)的构效关系及激动/拮抗活性，虽含配体对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Unsubstituted flavone induced CYP1A1, CYP1B1 and UGT1A1 gene expression in Caco2 cells and was characterized as an aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) agonist. The structure-activity relationships among 15 mono- and dihydroxyflavones showed that addition of one or two hydroxyl groups resulted in active (e.g.: 5- and 6- mono- and 5,6-dihydroxyflavones) and inactive (e.g.: 7-mono, 7,4' and 6,4'-dihydroxyflavones) AhR ligands. Ligand docking studies of flavone, mono- and dihydroxyflavones to the human AhR resulted in similar docking scores that varied from -3.48 to -4.58 kcal/mol and these values did not distinguish between AhR-active and AhR-inactive mono- and dihydroxyflavones. The AhR-inactive flavones were subsequently investigated as AhR antagonists by determining their activities as inhibitors of TCDD-induced expression of CYP1A1, CYP1AA2 and UGT 1A1 gene expression in Caco2 cells. Initial studies with 7,4'-dihydroxyflavone showed that this compound was an AhR antagonist in Caco2 cells and resembled the activity of the classical AhR antagonist CH223191. With few exceptions most of the remaining AhR-inactive compounds in terms of inducing AhR responsive genes were also AhR antagonists. Thus, based on modeling studies, mono- and dihydroxyflavones bind with similar affinities to the AhR and exhibit AhR agonist or antagonist activities, however, the structural requirements (substitution patterns) for predicting these opposing activities were not apparent and could only be determined using bioassays.
abstract_zh: 未取代的黄酮（flavone）在Caco2细胞中诱导CYP1A1、CYP1B1和UGT1A1基因表达，并被表征为芳烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR）激动剂。对15种单羟基和二羟基黄酮的构效关系研究表明，添加一个或两个羟基可产生具有活性（例如：5-和6-单羟基黄酮及5,6-二羟基黄酮）和无活性（例如：7-单羟基黄酮、7,4'-和6,4'-二羟基黄酮）的AhR配体。对黄酮、单羟基和二羟基黄酮与人AhR的配体对接研究产生了相似的对接分数，其范围从-3.48到-4.58 kcal/mol，这些数值无法区分具有AhR活性和无AhR活性的单羟基及二羟基黄酮。随后，通过测定这些无AhR活性的黄酮在Caco2细胞中抑制TCDD诱导的CYP1A1、CYP1A2和UGT1A1基因表达的能力，将其作为AhR拮抗剂进行研究。初步研究显示，7,4'-二羟基黄酮在Caco2细胞中是AhR拮抗剂，其活性类似于经典AhR拮抗剂CH223191。除少数例外，大多数其余在诱导AhR响应基因方面无活性的化合物也是AhR拮抗剂。因此，基于建模研究，单羟基和二羟基黄酮以相似的亲和力与AhR结合，并表现出AhR激动剂或拮抗剂活性，然而，预测这些相反活性的结构要求（取代模式）并不明显，只能通过生物测定来确定。
